name: What does finish carpentry include?
description: Finish carpentry involves installing visible, aesthetic elements like trim, molding, and built-ins to complete a home's interior look.

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry focuses on the visible, aesthetic elements of a home's interior, creating a polished and refined look. This includes the installation of trim, molding, baseboards, crown molding, door and window casings, wainscoting, and built-in shelving or cabinetry. The work typically happens after the main construction phases, like framing and drywall, are complete, ensuring a smooth and clean surface for these decorative elements. Choosing the right style and material for these components significantly impacts the overall architectural character and feel of your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry involves installing visible, aesthetic elements like trim, molding, and built-ins to complete a home's interior look.
